description: What each candidate's ballot paper said, kept apart from the party they stood for. Taken from the Electoral Office for Northern Ireland's result sheets (the 'Description' column, as given in the nomination paper); each contest names its sheet. Keyed by the candidate's name as the contest reads after source-checked fixes.
